title:
Helps the `ModelSetupJobsFilterPanel` filter properly {@ link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationJob}s and {@link ModelConfigRun}s.
On `Reliability.DataPreparationJobsGrid` and `Reliability.ModelConfigJobsGrid` respectively.
Prevents users from continuing if a row is not selected.
This epic is needed because the {@ JobStatusEnum} are different to {@ ReliabilityOrchestrator.RunStatus} and this filter panel
needs to be able to filter on both.
